arguments.query: find the only valid way to create a ServiceIdentifier; explain identifier caching and constructor dependency recording; identify a directly affected caller or importer if behavior changes
ServiceIdentifier createDecorator DI target key id dependency cache

arguments.symbol_signature: function createDecorator < T > ( serviceId : string ) : ServiceIdentifier < T >

trace.final_response:
`ServiceIdentifier<T>` must be created with `createDecorator<T>(serviceId)`, explicitly documented as the “only valid way” ([instantiation.ts:107](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-d790f11/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:107>)).

- Identifiers are cached in a module-level `Map<string, ServiceIdentifier<any>>` ([instantiation.ts:14](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-d790f11/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:14>)). `createDecorator` returns the existing function for a previously seen string; otherwise it creates the callable parameter decorator, makes `toString()` return the service ID, caches it, and returns it ([instantiation.ts:109](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-d790f11/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109>)). Thus equal service-ID strings have stable identifier identity within that module instance.

- When used on a constructor parameter, the identifier function requires exactly the decorator arguments `(target, key, index)` and records `{ id, index }` on the constructor’s `$di$dependencies` metadata ([instantiation.ts:115](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-d790f11/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:115>)). `storeServiceDependency` appends when the metadata belongs to that constructor; otherwise it creates an own array and marks `$di$target`, avoiding mutation of inherited metadata ([instantiation.ts:97](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-d790f11/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:97>)). Retrieval returns that array or `[]` ([instantiation.ts:19](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-d790f11/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:19>)).

A directly affected caller is `ITelemetryService`, which initializes its exported identifier by calling `createDecorator('telemetryService')` ([telemetry.ts:9](<{REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-d790f11/r01-huge-vscode-v0.4/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/telemetry/common/telemetry.ts:9>)). Any change to caching, identity, or decorator metadata recording affects this identifier and constructors decorated with it.

Thus equal service-ID strings yield the same object identity. [instantiation.ts:12]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-d790f11/r03-huge-vscode-plain/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:12) [instantiation.ts:109–125]({REPO_ROOT}/target/benchmarks/agent-navigation/final-d790f11/r03-huge-vscode-plain/huge-vscode/src/vs/platform/instantiation/common/instantiation.ts:109)
